# Tuteliq Swift SDK

> Official Swift SDK for Tuteliq — AI-powered child safety API for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS.

## What is this?
A Swift package for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, substance promotion, and other harmful content. Works with iOS 15+, macOS 12+, tvOS 15+, and watchOS 8+.

## Install
// Package.swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/tuteliq/tuteliq-swift.git", from: "1.0.0")

## Quick Start
import Tuteliq
let client = Tuteliq(apiKey: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["TUTELIQ_API_KEY"]!)
let result = try await client.detectUnsafe(text: "content to check", ageGroup: "13-15")

## Key Features
- Swift concurrency (async/await)
- All Apple platforms (iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS)
- All 20+ Tuteliq API endpoints
- 16+ detection categories (KOSA compliant)
- Age group calibration
- Swift Package Manager
